pr.body:
Bumps the actions group with 3 updates: [actions/upload-artifact](https://github.com/actions/upload-artifact), [SignPath/github-action-submit-signing-request](https://github.com/signpath/github-action-submit-signing-request) and [actions/download-artifact](https://github.com/actions/download-artifact). Updates `actions/upload-artifact` from 7.0.1 to 7.0.2
Release notes

Sourced from actions/upload-artifact's releases.

v7.0.2

What's Changed

  • Improves artifact download retries when the service returns HTTP 429 (rate limiting), including honoring valid Retry-After headers.
  • Updates @​actions/artifact to v6.3.1.

New Contributors

  • @​tunc-d made their first contribution in actions/upload-artifact#821

Full Changelog: https://github.com/actions/upload-artifact/compare/v7.0.1...v7.0.2

Commits
  • cf430e0 Merge pull request #822 from actions/tunc-d-prepare-upload-v7-0-2
  • c2acded chore: prepare v7.0.2 release
  • 4687c1b Merge pull request #821 from actions/tunc-d-upload-artifact-package-bump
  • 8cbe1be Bump @​actions/artifact to 6.3.1
  • See full diff in compare view

Updates `SignPath/github-action-submit-signing-request` from 2.3 to 3.0

Updates `actions/download-artifact` from 8.0.1 to 8.0.2
Release notes

Sourced from actions/download-artifact's releases.

v8.0.2

What's Changed

  • Update the readme by @​danwkennedy in actions/download-artifact#473
  • Improves artifact download retries when the service returns HTTP 429 (rate limiting), including honoring valid Retry-After headers.

issue.body:
Adds the agreed message-identifier and IMAP UID lifecycle plan to the engineering roadmap. The plan separates stable internal IDs from standard 32-bit IMAP identities and defines staged delivery for boundary fixes, transactional per-folder allocation, controlled UIDVALIDITY renewal, recovery and operator controls.

Acceptance covers signed/unsigned boundaries, exact API IDs, concurrency and notification ordering, stale-session fencing, crashes and backup/restore, client resynchronization, POP3 UIDLs, all supported databases and future SQLite. It explicitly avoids promises of unlimited per-folder capacity or invisible resync, and tracks correction/publication of the outdated database-maintenance page.

Refreshes README, roadmap, CI inventory and agent handoff to reflect merged PRs #36/#37 and the verified 312 management assertions per database at #36. Records the maintainer's deferred end-of-modernization CodeQL re-audit. The next proposed Phase 1b slice is mailbox forwarding and automatic replies, followed by remaining advanced administration, queue/rules/routes/listeners, DNS/DKIM lifecycle, SpamAssassin packaging, certificate management, Defender, hosting and PHP retirement.

This is documentation only. It starts no UID or administration implementation and makes no website or alert-state changes. Each implementation PR still requires separate maintainer confirmation.

Validation: all 70 local Markdown links in the edited documents resolved; git diff --check passed. No product runtime tests were run on the development host. CI passed on commit 6c39f8fe52692158fa99da78a417230e42eb2a20: Release x64, all four database regression/management jobs (Compact, MySQL, PostgreSQL and SQL Server Express), installer publication, CodeQL and gcc/clang portable-core checks.
